   - `createInvoice()` accepts and stores `discountPercent` on input lines
   - `addLine()` accepts and stores `discountPercent` on new lines

- Default discount behavior (0 when omitted)

The implementation follows the project rule: all computed amounts are clamped at zero minimum.
